item.title: The EBA advises on targeted simplifications to Taxonomy disclosures
item.description: The European Banking Authority (EBA) has published its response to the European Commission’s Call for Technical Advice on certain key performance indicators (KPIs) and other aspects of the Disclosures Delegated Act under Article 8 of the Taxonomy Regulation. The EBA advises on targeted changes to streamline disclosure requirements, reduce complexity and enhance the usability of information disclosed by credit institutions and investment firms.
item.dc:creator: Jana Jaklic

item.title: ​The EBA appoints Kristīne Černaja-Mežmale as its new Vice-Chair
item.description: ​The Board of Supervisors of the European Banking Authority (EBA) has elected Kristīne Černaja-Mežmale as its Vice-Chair for a duration of two and a half years. Ms Černaja-Mežmale will take up her new role on 1 November 2026 when the current EBA Vice-Chair, Helmut Ettl starts his new role as Executive Director of the International Monetary Fund (IMF).
item.dc:creator: Jana Jaklic

item.title: The ​EBA extends some consultation deadlines due to website maintenance​
item.description: On 21 October 2026, CERT-EU, the cybersecurity service for the EU institutions, bodies and agencies, alerted organisations to two critical security flaws in software used to run many websites, including that of the European Banking Authority (EBA). As a precaution, the EBA took its website offline on Wednesday 21 October 2026 at 13:00 CEST while the necessary security updates were applied. The website was restored on Thursday 22 October 2026 at 14:00 CEST.
item.dc:creator: Jana Jaklic

item.title: ​The EBA classifies USDC as the first significant e-money token in the European Union
item.description: ​The European Banking Authority (EBA) has classified USDC, issued by Circle Internet Financial Europe SAS, as a significant e-money token (EMT) under the Markets in Crypto Assets Regulation (MiCA), following its assessment of the criteria set out in the Regulation. There are currently 45 EMTs in the European Union, which have been notified under MiCA, and USDC is the first one to be classified as being significant.
item.dc:creator: Jana Jaklic

item.title: European Supervisory Authorities set priorities for 2027
item.description: The Joint Committee of the European Supervisory Authorities (EBA, EIOPA and ESMA – the ESAs) published today its Annual Work Programme for 2027, setting out its priorities for addressing cross-sectoral risks and strengthening coordination across the European Union's financial sector.
item.dc:creator: Jana Jaklic

item.title: ​The EBA releases the final technical package for release 4.4 of its reporting and Pillar 3 disclosure framework
item.description: ​The European Banking Authority (EBA) today released the final technical package for version 4.4 of its reporting and disclosure framework, covering IFRS 18 reporting, Pillar 3 ESG disclosures and other technical amendments.
item.dc:creator: Jana Jaklic

item.title: The EBA publishes Final Report on draft amendments to technical standards on prudential requirements for central securities depositories
item.description: The European Banking Authority (EBA) today published a report proposing draft amendments to the Regulatory Technical Standards (RTS) on certain prudential requirements for central securities depositories (CSDs) and designated credit institutions offering ‘banking-type ancillary services’. This mostly responds to changes introduced by the Central Securities Depositories Regulation (CSDR) “Refit”, notably those allowing banking CSDs to provide banking-type ancillary services to other CSDs.
item.dc:creator: Jana Jaklic

item.title: EBA CRR3/CRD6 dashboard shows banks maintain capital levels well above minimum requirements under the fully loaded Basel III framework
item.description: The European Banking Authority (EBA) today published its CRR3/CRD6 dashboard as of Q2 2026 for 129 banks at the highest level of consolidation across the EU/EEA. EU/EEA banks maintain capital levels well above minimum requirements under the fully loaded CRR3 framework, with an average Common Equity Tier 1 (CET1) ratio projected at 15.1%, despite an increased impact of the output floor compared with previous editions.
item.dc:creator: Jana Jaklic

item.title: ​The EBA publishes its 2027 Work Programme
item.description: ​The European Banking Authority (EBA) published today its Work Programme outlining the key areas of focus and deliverables for 2027. The Programme also marks the first step towards a broader medium-term strategy to position the EBA as a next-generation regulator, a body developing supervision at new frontiers, and a provider of services to the supervisory and resolution community.
item.dc:creator: Jana Jaklic

item.title: EU/EEA banks display strength amid a challenging risk environment
item.description: The European Banking Authority (EBA) today published its Risk Dashboard for the second quarter of 2026. It summarises the main risks and vulnerabilities of the EU/EEA banking sector based on supervisory reporting data.
item.dc:creator: Jana Jaklic
